'''Military Operations''' was a division of the [[Eternal Alliance]] founded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] to coordinate the Alliance's military and strategic intelligence assets.<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" />
